content:
**Stormswimmer** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

An uncommon fish that can be caught with Bait - Common, Bait - Improved and Bait - Superb. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 20 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Stormswimmer (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (5) | 

Can be found at any fishing spot in Skyline Valley.
